title: jams engine input map, format v1

$schema.description: The input-map JSON Schema this file follows.

players.description: The project's seats and how devices take them; omitted: the game's.

max.description: Seats, a whole number from 1 to 8.

join.description: auto: seat 0 owns keyboard, pointer and touch, and pads take free seats in connection order; press: a device's first press takes the lowest free seat; host: the host assigns devices.

deadzone.description: Radial stick deadzone, 0…1; omitted: the game's.

actions.description: Bindings per action; an action the map omits keeps the game's.

kind.description: The action's kind as the game declares it; omitted: the game's.

items.description: One binding: a key by `KeyboardEvent.code` ({ device: "key", code, axis?, value?, player? }), a pad button, stick or axis, a pointer button, or a touch control by id.

bindings.description: Every binding of the action; replaces the game's whole.

id.description: The control's id, which touch bindings name.

prefixItems.description: x, a fraction of the canvas's shorter side from its left edge.
y, a fraction of the canvas's shorter side from its top edge.

at.description: Where its centre sits, in fractions of the canvas's shorter side from its top-left corner.

radius.description: Its radius, a fraction of the canvas's shorter side.

description: The project's input map, at most one file per project: seats, stick deadzone, bindings per action and on-screen controls. Each action listed replaces the game's bindings for it whole.
